description: Defines the Overlay class and related classes for managing overlay widgets in ANGLE, including OverlayState, Overlay, and DummyOverlay implementations.

classes.name: OverlayState
classes.description: Manages overlay widget states and buffers.

classes.name: Overlay
classes.description: Handles overlay widget creation, initialization, and access.

classes.name: DummyOverlay
classes.description: A dummy implementation of overlay for when overlay is disabled.

methods.name: getWidgetCoordinatesBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of widget coordinates buffer.

methods.name: getTextWidgetsBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of text widgets buffer.

methods.name: getGraphWidgetsBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of graph widgets buffer.

methods.name: fillEnabledWidgetCoordinates
methods.description: Fills buffer with enabled widget coordinates.

methods.name: Overlay
methods.description: Main overlay class managing overlay widgets.

methods.name: Overlay(rx::GLImplFactory *implFactory)
methods.description: Constructor initializing overlay with implementation factory.

methods.name: getPerSecondWidget
methods.description: Returns per second widget by ID.

methods.name: getRunningGraphWidget
methods.description: Returns running graph widget by ID.

methods.name: getRunningHistogramWidget
methods.description: Returns running histogram widget by ID.

methods.name: getWidgetAs
methods.description: Template method to cast widget to specific type.

methods.name: enableOverlayWidgetsFromEnvironment
